---
name: bmad-retrospective
description: Review a completed feature or deployment to identify practical lessons and follow-up improvements. Use when asked for a retrospective.
---

# Retrospective

Use evidence from the change, tests, deployment, and user feedback. Identify
what helped, what caused friction, root causes, and a few owned/actionable
improvements. Avoid blame and generic advice. Do not change files or create
tickets unless requested.
